theme: Core Data models: the blueprint, the object and the fetch request

terms.definition: A blueprint that lists the kinds of objects, and their fields, that the app can store.
terms.example: Add the new field to the managed object model.

terms.definition: The base class for every object that the framework creates and stores for you.
terms.example: Each note is an NSManagedObject with a title.

terms.definition: A request that asks for stored objects of one type and returns the ones it finds.
terms.example: Build an NSFetchRequest for all unread notes.
terms.code:
import CoreData
let r = NSFetchRequest<NSManagedObject>(
    entityName: "Note")
r.fetchLimit = 10
print(r.entityName ?? "none")

video.title: Managed Object Model, NSManagedObject & NSFetchRequest | Day 212
video.description:
Learn to explain how Core Data describes, creates and finds stored objects: Managed Object Model, NSManagedObject & NSFetchRequest, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Managed Object Model - A blueprint that lists the kinds of objects, and their fields, that the app can store.
NSManagedObject - The base class for every object that the framework creates and stores for you.
NSFetchRequest - A request that asks for stored objects of one type and returns the ones it finds.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Managed Object Model, NSManagedObject & NSFetchRequest in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
Managed Object Model, NSManagedObject, NSFetchRequest 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Managed Object Model - A blueprint that lists the kinds of objects, and their fields, that the app can store.
한국어: Managed Object Model: 앱이 저장할 수 있는 객체 종류와 그 필드를 적어 둔 설계도

NSManagedObject - The base class for every object that the framework creates and stores for you.
한국어: NSManagedObject: 프레임워크가 만들고 저장하는 모든 객체의 기본 클래스

NSFetchRequest - A request that asks for stored objects of one type and returns the ones it finds.
한국어: NSFetchRequest: 한 종류의 저장된 객체를 찾아 돌려 달라고 요청하는 객체

landscape.hook: Can you explain Managed Object Model, NSManagedObject and NSFetchRequest in English?

dialogue.title: Describe it, then fetch it

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, I added a `title` field to `Note`, but the app crashes.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Did you update the managed object model?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: The managed object model. It is the blueprint that lists every object type and its fields.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Oh, so the class alone is not enough.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Right. In our code, `Note` is an NSManagedObject, but the model must describe it too.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Okay, I fixed the model. Now how do I load the notes?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Make an NSFetchRequest, like `r` in our code.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Does the NSFetchRequest return the notes right away?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No. It is only the question. The context runs it and gives you the results.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Got it. Every NSManagedObject comes from that blueprint.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Exactly. Keep the model and the class in sync.
The managed object model is our blueprint.
